title: Podium audit event, version 1
description: One Podium audit record as a destination receives it: one JSON object per line. A record without schema_version predates version 1 and is outside this schema. Such records remain in a file destination after an upgrade and keep their hashes. This file is never edited after release; a change to the record's members ships a new version.

type.description: The event type, a dotted lowercase name such as artifact.loaded. A new event type is not a schema change.

timestamp.description: The time the event occurred, as an RFC 3339 time in UTC.

trace_id.description: The trace identifier of the request the event serves.

caller.description: The caller that raised the event.

network.description: The network attributes recorded for a public-mode call.

public_mode.description: Present and true when the registry served the call in public mode.

client.description: The normalized, self-reported client software of the request the event serves.

target.description: The object the event acts on, such as an artifact ID.

tenant.description: The org ID whose audit stream the event belongs to. Absent on deployment-wide events.

resolved_layers.description: The ordered layer composition of the caller's effective view, recorded on read events.

result_size.description: The number of result items a read event returned.

hash.description: The chain hash, the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical body followed by prev_hash. Receivers deduplicate on it.

prev_hash.description: The hash of the preceding record in the stream. Absent on the first record.
